issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for Stock.findStockIngredient: the problem statement UML and the solution repository declare findStockIngredient(String name) (single String parameter), whereas the template repository declares findStockIngredient(String name, boolean caseSensitive) (two parameters). This mismatch causes compilation errors in the template because other template methods (e.g., add/take) call findStockIngredient with a single String argument. Students following the UML or solution will be blocked by the template's differing method signature.
